newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA'S RABSI UP 0.26 PTS ON TWO ISSUES' RISE.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA'S RABSI UP 0.26 PTS ON TWO ISSUES' RISE.

text.p: The RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) gained 0.26 points from Thursday to 41.28 as two corporate issues rose, brokers said.
TBS Hotels sold 50 second issue shares at 102 levs on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE), up 22 levs from Thursday's close and below par of 1,000.
A total of 30 Razvitie Investment Fund third issue stocks sold at 35 levs on the BSE, up three from Thursday but well below par of 100, said traders.
Total turnover amounted to 6,150 levs, up from 3,480 on Thursday and traded volume rose to 80 units from 40.
Two seven-day repo deals in treasury paper worth 2.898 million levs were struck on the BSE and the Sofia Stock Exchange with yield to repurchase 4.85 and 4.90 percent respectively.
No repo deals were struck on local bourses on Thursday.
